hero.title: You deserve a space to be truly heard.
hero.subtitle: Compassionate, culturally sensitive counselling and psychotherapy in Ottawa — in person and online, in English, French, and Somali.

intro.heading: Meet Sahra
intro.body: Sahra Haji-Mohamed Said is a Registered Social Worker (RSW) with over a decade of clinical experience and up to fifteen years of community work supporting children, teens, adults, seniors, and families. She offers a warm, non-judgmental space where your story is heard with care — and where your cultural and spiritual background is honoured, not sidelined. Sahra believes you already carry the strength to reclaim control of your life; her role is simply to help you see your own resilience.

individual.title: Individual Psychotherapy
individual.description: One-on-one sessions to work through anxiety, stress, trauma, grief, and more, at your own pace.

couple.title: Couple Therapy
couple.description: A guided space to rebuild communication, trust, and connection with your partner.

group.title: Group Therapy
group.description: Shared healing in a supportive group setting guided by a trained facilitator.

spiritual.title: Spiritual Therapy
spiritual.description: Counselling that welcomes faith and spirituality as part of your healing journey, including Islamic counselling.

cbt.title: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy
cbt.description: Practical tools to understand and reshape unhelpful thought patterns.

narrative.title: Narrative Therapy
narrative.description: Reframing your story so the problem is the problem — not you.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness
mindfulness.description: Grounding techniques to stay present and ease overwhelm.

artTherapy.description: Creative, playful approaches especially suited to children and teens.
